rules: When required to draw a Bone card, may first roll d10; on 4 or greater, prevent that draw.

name: Black Truck
rules: Choose before any movement dice to use two d6 and move by their sum. While doing so, do not use other movement-affecting Items, Homies, or character powers.

name: ’84 Regal
rules: Before rolling movement, may choose to move up to two spaces in either direction instead of making the usual movement roll.

name: Panic Attack
rules: For three of your turns, any combat victory becomes a tie. Mortal Combat is exempt. Discard after the duration.
notes: The card does not specify whether a partly completed turn in which it is drawn counts toward the three.

name: Karmageddon
rules: Cannot retain newly acquired Cash, Items, or Homies; immediately discard new acquisitions. Landing on Oz removes the condition.

name: The Runs
rules: Lose one turn.

name: Amputation
rules: Roll d6. Results 1–3 reduce Item capacity to three; results 4–6 reduce movement rolls by two, with a minimum movement of one. Pay $300 at the Hospital to remove the condition.
notes: The card does not explain how its capacity limit combines with capacity-enhancing Items.

name: Skitsofrantic
rules: The player seated to your left controls your moves, choices, and required rolls for your next two turns. Discard afterward.
notes: A digital version must define a stable seating order; the card refers to physical seating, not arbitrary join-list order.

name: Random Bone Generator
rules: Reduce every noncombat roll by one, including movement, which still has a minimum of one space. This Item cannot be voluntarily removed until landing on Chaos District, when it is discarded.
notes: Its printed category is Item, despite coming from the Bones deck. Forced removal, theft, and inventory-capacity interactions require the general rules.
The minimum of one is explicitly for movement; the card does not set a universal minimum noncombat die result.

name: Slippery Palms
rules: Weapons cannot be used during combat. Visiting Playaz Strip Club removes this condition.

name: King High Bone
rules: Remove the player token and exclude the player from participation for ten real minutes. Return the token to the same space without another encounter; resume movement on the next turn.
notes: The return timer uses real minutes, not ten turns. The card does not address pauses, disconnection, or wall-clock suspension.

name: Transfer the Bone
rules: Choose another player to draw one Bone card immediately.

name: Concussion
rules: Movement must proceed clockwise, but crossing regions remains allowed. A movement roll of 6 removes the condition.
notes: Whether a modified result or either die of a two-die movement power counts as the needed 6 is not specified by this card.

name: Crabs
rules: Movement rolls are reduced by two, but movement remains at least one space. Pay $100 at the Hospital to remove it.

name: Insanity
rules: Automatically lose combat against another player until three of your turns have passed. Discard afterward.
notes: The card does not say whether the current partly completed turn counts. Unlike Panic Attack, it prints no Mortal Combat exemption; ending-specific precedence still requires the rules.

name: Amnesia
rules: Character powers cannot be used until landing on the character’s starting space. Discard after reaching it.

name: The Necronomicon
rules: Use the revealed ending rules.

name: Milenko’s Wand
rules: Use the revealed ending rules.

name: Crystal Skull
rules: Use the revealed ending rules.
